name: digitalfinancekay
creator: I read the annual reports of famous companies and show, in sixty seconds, where their money really comes from.
cta: Follow for a new company every day
voiceNote: Speeds are set so every voice reads at about 180 words a minute over a whole script, pauses included (the pace of the first pilots). They were measured on full scripts for am_michael, bf_emma and am_fenrir; the others are estimates and the duration check catches any that run long. Video N uses voice (N-1) mod 8, so neighbours never share a voice. A script can name one with `voice:` in its front matter. A recorded voice.wav always wins.
